# sql.js 1.15.2 (pinned copy)

- **What:** SQLite compiled to WebAssembly, so the SQL exercise pages run in your browser with nothing to install. The `inline` build carries the WebAssembly inside the JavaScript file, so the pages work when you open them straight from your disk.
- **Source:** the official sql.js release v1.15.2 (26 October 2026), asset `sql-wasm-inline.js`, from github.com/sql-js/sql.js.
- **SHA-256:** `35abf6bfd37f1fbb661976e04ea4cc21664e3ba7574e622f92ee4f1080d12330`, which matches the digest GitHub records for that release asset.
- **Licence:** MIT, see `LICENSE` in this folder.
- Downloaded on 10 November 2026, and kept here so readers never fetch it from anywhere else.
